desc: Derive and verify the gap-swap transformation for a 4-block, including that all coordinates remain integers and distinct.
Prove reachability: swaps (i,i+2) generate full symmetric groups on odd and even gap positions, and no cross-parity permutation is possible.
Derive the objective formula: sum of coordinates = N*X_1 + Σ_{k=1}^{N-1} (N-k)g_k, and list the fixed weights for odd/even gap indices.

Implement the Python solution: read N and X, compute consecutive gaps, split gaps by 1-indexed parity, sort each parity list ascending, compute weighted sum with decreasing weights, print ans; sample tests passed.
